name: Cinema Collection
desc: Iconic film moments and original movie poster art, reimagined on silk. One Sheet size matches the theatrical standard.

name: Anime Universe
desc: Anime and manga-inspired art, from classic cel-shading to contemporary digital illustration.

name: Legends Gallery
desc: Iconic figures — musicians, athletes, actors, thinkers — co-created with visual artists. Not photos, but artistic interpretations.

name: Sonic Echoes
desc: Album art, band posters, and music-inspired visual art. The visual language of sound, on silk.

name: Palace Reimagined
desc: Forbidden City motifs, imperial patterns, and museum artifacts — reimagined by contemporary artists. Beijing, Taipei, and beyond.

name: Dunhuang Reimagined
desc: Dunhuang frescoes, flying apsaras, and Silk Road heritage — brought to life on the very material that once traveled the route.

name: Nantian Gate
desc: Deities, immortals, and mythological figures from Chinese folklore. Character-driven, powerful, and contemporary.

name: Eastern Mood
desc: Abstract Eastern aesthetics — negative space, ink washes, floral stillness. Mood over narrative, feeling over form.

name: Cyber Orient
desc: Neon-lit futurism fused with Eastern iconography. Cyberpunk cities, techno-geishas, and digital dynasty aesthetics.

name: Eastern Street
desc: Graffiti, street art, and urban culture with Eastern roots. Where the gallery meets the alleyway.

name: The Other Gaze
desc: Non-Eastern artists interpreting Eastern themes. A dedicated category for Western creators to redefine Oriental aesthetics.

name: Eastern Sci-Fi
desc: Science fiction through an Eastern lens — mythical beasts reimagined as mecha, ancient futures, and cosmic mythology.
